description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git's rename and copy detection features, particularly focusing on how pathspecs influence the detection process. It contains preparation steps, test cases with expected outputs, and assertions to verify Git's behavior under various scenarios related to copying and renaming files in a Git repository.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects the command to succeed and verifies the output against expected results.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Runs a command and checks that it exits with the specified code.
